en.subtitle: Junior IT System Administrator | IT Support L1/L2 | Windows · Networking · Security & Backups
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior IT System Administrator position. I currently provide hands-on IT support for a dental practice — Windows workstations, hardware and software faults, installations, peripherals, and documented follow-up for non-technical users — while administering Linux servers (VPS, Docker, Nginx, SSL) with uptime monitoring and production incident resolution.

My infrastructure experience covers the foundations your role asks for: Ethernet cabling, IP addressing and subnetting, router and firewall configuration, secure remote access, access control, SSL, and backup discipline — including automated backups in a rental-management ERP I built. I maintain IT documentation and asset records, communicate clearly with non-technical users, and work independently while collaborating with the broader team. I also use Python for task automation, which gives me a practical basis for learning PowerShell.

I hold a Bachelor in Information Systems (Highest Honors) and work in professional English and French. I am keen to deepen my Active Directory and Entra ID skills within a Microsoft-centric team, and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can support your IT operations.
